definitions.explanation: Describes a device that runs on a built-in battery which is recharged rather than replaced. Almost always used before a noun with の, or as a product-description label.

examples.japanese: {充電式|じゅうでんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{掃除機|そうじき}→掃除機：04967_soujiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{充電式|じゅうでんしき}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦コード→コード：00241_koodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いらない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This vacuum cleaner is rechargeable, so it doesn't need a cord.

examples.japanese: {充電式|じゅうでんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確|たし}かめた→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Rechargeable tools are convenient, but you should check how much battery is left before using them.

notes:
⟦{充電|じゅうでん}→充電：04427_juuden⟧ (charging) + {式|しき} (type, system). The {式|しき} suffix forms product-type labels, as in {電池式|でんちしき} (battery-operated) or {手動式|しゅどうしき} (manual).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {充電式|じゅうでんしき}⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧: rechargeable battery
- {充電式|じゅうでんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除機|そうじき}→掃除機：04967_soujiki⟧: cordless vacuum cleaner
- {充電式|じゅうでんしき}⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧: rechargeable light

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {電池式|でんちしき}: battery-operated — uses disposable batteries that are replaced, not recharged
- コードレス: cordless — emphasizes the absence of a cord rather than the charging method
